{{recipesummary|category=Dumpling recipes|servings=4|time=Prep: 20 minutes
Cooking: 20 minutes|difficulty=2 }}{{Recipe}} == Ingredients == * 5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] * 10 white bread rolls, cut into small cubes * 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] * ~3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] * 1 bunch of [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], washed and chopped * ~7 tbsp [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|flour]] * 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] white [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] == Procedure == # Heat the oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]]. Add the diced onions, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until translucent. Remove from the heat. # Combine the bread cubes and the cooked onions. # Mix the eggs with the milk, and pour it over the bread and the onions. Mix to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. # Mix the parsley and flour into the dough. Season with salt and pepper. # Form balls of the dough about the size of tennis balls. # [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the knoedel in salted water. After about 2 minutes, turn the temperature down to a lower setting and let them boil for another 10–15 minutes.
